source: VVOB Cambodia / MAFF Kampong Thom Provincial Department of Agriculture — IPM and Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) for Rice, 9-point training presentation, presenter Mr. Tem Seng, Oct 5, 2010 (training slide deck; no elibrary URL visible)
text: Seed grain intended for the next season's planting should be stored separately from rice kept for household consumption, and kept in a dry, well-ventilated container such as a woven basket or a clean, airtight vessel to protect it from insects and moisture (រកសាទុកកន្ត្រកស្អាត ដាក់ក្នុងធុងផ្លាស្ទិចដ៏ល្អ ដាច់ដោយឡែកពីស្រូវសម្រាប់ប្រើប្រាស់ធម្មតា). Farmers are advised to label each seed lot with the variety name so seed of different varieties is not mixed at planting time, since mixed seed lots make it harder to manage uniform growth and harvest timing later. Using well-selected, properly stored seed pays off through better field uniformity, so it is worth reducing the total quantity of grain kept as seed (since seed requires more careful handling) rather than storing large volumes carelessly.
